kamloops.title: Thousands remain under evacuation order due to wildfire on west side of Okanagan Lake
kamloops.description: The B.C. Wildfire Service said the Quilpituk Creek wildfire experienced significant growth on Monday, but it is growing up the slope and away from community areas.

kamloops.title: B.C. man watches his home of 31 years burn in the Bradley Creek wildfire
kamloops.description: "We were holding our own, but homes around me began to start on fire and it changed the whole game," Jeff Moore, whose cabin was on Okanagan Lake, told Global News.

kamloops.title: 230 homes may have been lost to Bradley Creek wildfire near Vernon: chief
kamloops.description: 'For our community, it's measured in homes, family histories and places people have spent all of their lives,' Chief Dan Wilson of the Okanagan Indian Band said.

kamloops.title: Hamburgers, water and support waiting for B.C. fire evacuees
kamloops.description: With thousands forced from their homes due to fires around Okanagan Lake, the Salvation Army in Vernon has become a place for people to gather as they figure out what's next.
